name: Basketball
description: Basketball from a gym class in Massachusetts in 1891 to the NBA and the world: the leagues, teams and greatest players.

checkpoints.name: A new game
checkpoints.note: James Naismith invents basketball in 1891. Colleges and touring teams like the Harlem Globetrotters spread it across America.

checkpoints.name: The NBA's first stars
checkpoints.note: The NBA forms in 1946. Bill Russell's Celtics win again and again, and Chamberlain and Kareem rewrite the records.

checkpoints.name: Magic, Bird and Jordan
checkpoints.note: Magic Johnson and Larry Bird revive the league, Michael Jordan's Bulls win six titles, and the Dream Team takes the game to the world.

checkpoints.name: A global game
checkpoints.note: Kobe, LeBron and Curry lead new eras, the WNBA grows, and stars come from China, Europe and Africa.
